materialization: Generated deterministically at evaluation time against the model tokenizer/backend so dependency distances are exact in model tokens.
reservation: This suite and every deterministic materialization derived from it are project-owned reserved evaluation material. They must not enter tokenizer fitting, corpus packaging, pretraining, fine-tuning, or data augmentation.
decontamination_binding: source_purpose=evaluation_test is already forbidden by data/s0/contamination_registry.json
truth_boundary: In-range conditional next-token dependency diagnostic only. No instruction-following, intelligence, or beyond-context extrapolation claim.
